title: A Word Without a Doorway

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A hand may stay a breath past the check and no house can enter it; a word may come over the boards and stand in no doorway to be asked. The strip stays in the sleeve, the crack stays showing, and the fifth pull is not supplied.
epigraph.attribution: A yard saying of Low Kiln, in the dark month

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and forty-five to three hundred and forty-seven days, six months and one hundred and sixty-five to one hundred and sixty-seven days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning that register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and forty-five, forty-six and forty-seven days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, never numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources. The heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself. Seven arithmetics of the year stand behind one unsigned figure in Berr Clay's locked box up the clay road, seven readings seven and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer; Ash's second stands two mornings beyond the close and is not brought into a day that has not earned it.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Sixteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{345}{Ash 16, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Sixthday, with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 264 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, and carry 344 to 345 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-five days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 345 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). No recap of Chapter 97: nothing from the thirteenth, fourteenth or fifteenth crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the breath held at the knife-sill stayed where it was put and buys no lesson under this roof. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear, stiff and leathery in the dry kiln heat, corner standing a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, neither wins; the argument is the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline left showing, turns the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule, the sixth held behind at the kiln mouth on Ash 2 without a name, and no seventh made due. Seven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure, seven readings seven and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer; Ash's second stands two mornings ahead on a day that has not earned it and is not brought early (T015/T041/T047). The hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the note's own finishing and comes straight down as a tool put away — answer **265**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the seven arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, the notched wood nor his own gaps (T061/T082). Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner, no collector this morning. Exact last image: the file lies open on the towel at the head of the bed with every gap left gap, the twice-mended pot stands on the pot board with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, and the hand is laid back against the fold on answer 265 while the river goes water over water through the finger's-width door.

scenes.title: What the Yard Goes Around on the Sixteenth
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 16 through the going of the light and the bed, at the Clay Yard, the seven walked-around places, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the damper, then the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; walk-ons (the Cold Acre hare-carrier answering the price with the weather and going toward the clay road with the hare unweighed, the man with a cracked jar in a rope sling sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with a basket of kindling asking what the seventh year will want, two men mending a strip of fence saying the thaw will be early and late); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa, no runner, no collector, no market, Cross or bell. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number — the clean dark line at the Vail corner with the finer grey hairline called the thaw beside it unswept both, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring with no scrape or crumb or print, the trough's skin, the field's empty place on the worked strips, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — and enters none, because a thing entered wants a payer and none stands (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The dressed grain lies turned under wool at the rack end with no figure; Sella's fingers go in and come out without closing, so no handful is lifted, and the empty fingers go beside the one object of Bone 22 as a keeping and not a second handful (T077). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures; Tarn says *Yes, house* to the early thaw and the late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot (T077, T036/T076). At the kindling he keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence; the small knife lies at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where a hand could also slip it off; he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, checks the thumb's resting of Bone 26 and does not make it again, and checks the held breath at the knife-sill of Ash 14 and finds it where it was put — hand to the sill, over the knife as the house checks, away when the checking is done, no breath staying at the top of the reach — not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a sixth held object, not made again and joined to no other keeping (T036/T076/T006 advanced, not paid). His stroke goes over the bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check; the returned half-check of Bone 8 stays with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat, four held changes on four places and not a rule; the warm loft stone lies cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness. Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip; parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel; speaks to the wheel before any person (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*) and tells a pot *You'll do*; knows the full note it will give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it; puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of it arrives at the pot, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn; the burned slate stays at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no sixth, the Ash 5 joining held apart, and no ownerless saying comes over the boards this afternoon. At the going of the light Sella carries him up at the half-pace and wide around the seven places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted fold, half-beat at setting, thread left frozen; the widow's mark is not touched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings. The twice-mended pot comes up thumb-first at the wire with the crack showing and both proverbs to pot and fire. In the small hours the hand goes up an inch, small intake, interval held whole on the river's own finishing, straight down — answer **266**, a restraint and not a payment. Exact last image: the hand laid back against the fold on answer 266, one crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen, and the carried fire keeping four and a gap under the floor with its payer unnamed three hundred and forty-five days.

scenes.title: The Seventeenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{346}{Ash 17, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner this morning. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 16 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 345 to 346 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-six days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 346 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust gone stiffer and browner in the dry kiln heat two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot; the infant's want of the crust lifted, thread wiped and hand on the pot handle louder than the surgeon's knowing, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; *The house will keep it*; a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule, the sixth held behind at Ash 2, and no seventh made due. The boy checks the whole private file as a surgeon checks a field before the light: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told; the told figure beside the paid with no signature on the space; seven arithmetics seven and not one account with Ash's first locked up the clay road; nine record-first hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them and the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that, each on its own place with a finger between and none a sixth or a seventh (T061/T082, T090, T036/T076/T006, T058/T079). He sets down what is there and looks for nothing to fill the empty places, because a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged. The hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down as a tool put away — answer **267**, worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). Exactly no voice comes over the boards in the small hours; the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning of the runner's writing stay on their places unspent and unpromoted. Exact last image: the hand laid back against the fold on answer 267, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the boards keeping four nails on the near one, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not.

scenes.title: The Word That Stood Nowhere
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, chapter close of the second day and the chapter's one meaningful change, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 17 at the Clay Yard, the boards, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the damper, then the going of the light, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Ilva (once at the well, pail against her knee, strip unread, ninth hand nine), Tarn, Jorra Vail; walk-ons (a woman waiting her turn at the well asking what Ash's firings have taken, the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders); Garl in objects. No Berr, no Hessa, no runner seen on any road, no collector up or down the clay road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no market, Cross or bell. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T035/T031/T065/T095, held with T101):** in the afternoon a voice with no owner comes over the boards from the direction of Slate Row, spoken over the boards and not to the basket, giving a word about a room shut with the damper closed and a slate burned over a man nobody names — a direction with no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date standing and nobody standing in any doorway to be asked; the weather answers first and the price of barley after it, and the voice goes off up the terrace while the boards lie where they lay. The boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and files it on a place of its own **beside** the Ash 5 joining of the burned slate to the room with the damper shut, with a finger between every pair: a further shaping of that joining and an advancement of the finding that a place wants a witness and a witness is a day somebody stands somewhere and can be asked — expressly NOT a sixth telling of the burned slate (which stays at five with a finger between the fifth and the four), NOT a third telling of the counting room shut in the war (which stays at two), NOT a sixth asking of the row (which stays at five with one shaping and no witness), NOT a fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying (which stays at four), NOT a hearing, NOT a seventh of the full note, NOT a cause, NOT a confession and NOT a payment, with no payer standing and no reader, witness or name made of it; advanced and not paid. Ilva draws at the yard well with the pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; to the woman who asks what Ash's firings have taken her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays — the strip of notched birch not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any saying that arrived nowhere, no figure off the wood — and her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* (T080 advanced, not paid). The boy files her reaching as the **ninth** record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, files **no tenth**, and expressly does **not** make her the speaker of the ownerless voice: she is not the voice, no fifth shaping came of her well, and the turning of the runner's writing stays a sighting. The yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful lifted; the hunts and repairs are answered with the weather, the pot and the carrying arm; Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, knife at the edge of its sill, held breath of Ash 14 checked and not made again, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, *Yes, house* to early and late while keeping the late; Jorra's bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, the full note known ahead and withheld, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn — he grows quieter when the direction goes around the boards and the household straightens around the quiet without an order, and the claim goes on gathering interest against the ungiven promise (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella carries him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted, half-beat at setting, thread left frozen, widow's mark untouched; the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first with the crack showing and both proverbs to pot and fire. In the small hours the hand goes up an inch, small intake, interval held whole on the river's own finishing, straight down as a tool put away — answer **268**, a restraint and not a payment. Exact last image: the hand laid back against the fold on answer 268, the twice-mended pot standing on the pot board with the hairline showing, and the voice gone up the terrace with nobody having stood in any doorway to ask it anything.

scenes.title: The Eighteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{347}{Ash 18, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Eighthday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner this morning. New day, new date, no recap; the word that came over the boards on the seventeenth went up the terrace and stands nowhere to be asked, and it buys no lesson under this roof (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, advanced and not paid). Carry 346 to 347 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-seven days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 347 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust stiff and leathery two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; the infant's want of the crust lifted, thread wiped and hand on the pot handle louder than the surgeon's knowing, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds at both ends of the day's opening: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; *The house will keep it*; intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule, the sixth held behind at Ash 2 without a name, and no seventh made due. Seven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure, seven readings seven and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer; Ash's first rides locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay's box, and Ash's second stands two mornings ahead on Ash 20 and is named only as a date, never as a promise, never brought into a day that has not earned it and never supplied with an eighth arithmetic early (T015/T041/T047). Three hundred and forty-seven is not a threshold and is not round; nobody marks it, and he has long since stopped expecting to be told what a number counts, which is not the same as not wanting it (T071/T072). The hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down as a tool put away — answer **269**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment (T061/T082). Exact last image: the hand laid back against the fold on answer 269, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, and three hundred and forty-seven standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody under the Vail roof.

scenes.title: Six Behind One Figure, Held
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 18 at the Clay Yard's seven places, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the going of the light, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; walk-ons (the Cold Acre hare-carrier answering the price with the weather, the man with a cracked jar in a rope sling sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa, no runner seen on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no collector up or down the clay road, no market, Cross or bell. The yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number — clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw unswept both, space under the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring, the trough's skin, the field's empty place, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet, the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried) — the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085), and the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful lifted (T077). The hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather; Tarn says *Yes, house* to early and late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, checks the held breath at the knife-sill and does not make it again, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there — nine stoppings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note known three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella carries him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted, half-beat at setting, thread left frozen; widow's mark untouched, six openings in six months not a rule and no seventh made due; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with crack showing and both proverbs to pot and fire; dressed grain turned once under wool with fingers going in and coming out without closing. The whole tray is checked and left as it lay: six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself; the told figure beside the paid with no signature on the space; seven arithmetics seven and not one account; nine record-first hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth; the row at five askings with one shaping and no sixth; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair, none spent, named, joined, promoted into a witness, a sixth telling, a third shut-room telling, a sixth asking, a fifth shaping, a cause, a payment or a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T090, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101). Garl stays in objects and not in a story: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with the finer grey, twice-mended pot with the hairline showing, unforged collector sentence beside the knife, tile debt uncalled, name unspoken three hundred and forty-seven days. In the small hours the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note, does not reach, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the note's own finishing and comes straight down and laid back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking — answer **270**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the seven arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, the notched wood nor his own gaps. **Two hundred and seventy honest answers** stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082). The count closes at **347 exact**, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and one hundred and sixty-seven days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed and Garl's name unspoken the same. Ash kept its eighteenth day without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months was set right or left wrong; nothing on the eighteenth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended; no runner came on any road and no collector up or down the clay road; there was no market, Cross or bell. Exact last image: the hand laid down against the fold on answer 270 and the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap, the twice-mended pot standing on the pot board with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, one stiff brown-edged crust two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, and Ash 20 standing two mornings ahead and named only as a date — the keeping of the number bought nothing at two inches of air and goes on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. Forward, not closed.
